name: Mueller
description: Mueller is Austin's premier mixed-use community, built on the former Robert Mueller Municipal Airport site. This walkable, bike-friendly neighborhood features tree-lined streets, abundant green spaces, and a vibrant town center. As part of the Mueller master HOA, residents enjoy access to community amenities including a public pool, parks, and year-round community events.

hoaAmenities.title: Mueller HOA Community Amenities
hoaAmenities.description: As part of the Mueller master-planned community, all residents enjoy access to shared amenities maintained by the Mueller HOA — from a resort-style pool to miles of trails and year-round community events.

items.name: Community Pool & Splash Pad
items.description: Resort-style community swimming pool with splash pad, lounge seating, and seasonal hours for all Mueller residents.

items.name: Mueller Lake Park
items.description: 30-acre centerpiece park featuring a 6-acre lake, walking trails, open meadows, playgrounds, and public art installations.
items.imageAlt: Mueller Lake Park with trails and lake

items.name: Hike & Bike Trails
items.description: Miles of interconnected trails for walking, running, and cycling throughout the Mueller community connecting to the citywide trail network.

items.name: Community Events
items.description: Year-round programming including movie nights, holiday celebrations, fitness classes, and neighborhood gatherings at community spaces.

items.name: Parks & Playgrounds
items.description: Multiple pocket parks and playgrounds throughout the neighborhood, including John Gaines Park and the Southwest Greenway.

items.name: Dog-Friendly Spaces
items.description: Dedicated off-leash dog areas and pet-friendly trails throughout the Mueller community for four-legged residents.

lifestyle.title: The Mueller Lifestyle
lifestyle.description: More than a neighborhood — Mueller is a community designed around how you want to live.

features.title: Mueller Farmers Market
features.description: Every Sunday, the Mueller Farmers Market brings together local farmers, artisan food vendors, live music, and community spirit. One of Austin's most popular markets, it's a weekly tradition for Mueller residents — just steps from your front door.

features.title: Walkable Town Center
features.description: Mueller's town center puts everyday essentials and entertainment within walking distance. From a full-service H-E-B grocery to Alamo Drafthouse Cinema, local restaurants, and specialty shops — daily life doesn't require a car.
features.imageAlt: Mueller town center with shops and restaurants

features.title: Minutes from Downtown
features.description: Located just 3 miles from downtown Austin, Mueller offers the best of both worlds — a quiet residential community with fast access to the city center, UT campus, the Capitol, and Austin's vibrant food and music scene.
features.imageAlt: Mueller aerial view with downtown Austin skyline
